name: Mary of Bethany
bio: Mary of Bethany sat at Jesus's feet listening to him while her sister Martha busied herself serving, during a visit to their village; when Martha complained, Jesus commended Mary for choosing the one necessary thing (Luke 10:38-42). She is a different figure from Mary the mother of Jesus and Mary Magdalene. Her further role, alongside her sister and brother Lazarus, is told in detail in the chapters ahead.
